title: Jacques Vallée's photo of a UFO over a lake, with every cow looking at it

tellings.quote: the cows every cow in that picture was looking at the UFO

plain: A photograph is said to show a UFO over a lake, and every cow in the picture is turned toward it. The guest Joe McMoneagle tells this as a photo he links to the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée, stressing that "every cow in that picture was looking at the UFO." The point is that the animals seem to have noticed something real in the sky.
